name: minecraft-with-bunnyhopping
description: BhopCraft: a browser Minecraft-style voxel game whose player movement is a port of Counter-Strike: Source movement (bunnyhopping + air strafing).
author: Libor Burian

scripts.experiments: tsx experiments/run-all.ts --stage exp01 && tsx experiments/run-all.ts --stage exp02-pilot && uv run python analysis/power.py && tsx experiments/run-all.ts --stage exp02-confirm && uv run python analysis/analyze.py && uv run python analysis/build_paper.py
